quote: Automatic generation of counterspeech has been researched to support timely and effective efforts to fight hate speech.
We experiment with LLMs for generating outcome-constrained counterspeech using instruction prompts, LLM finetuning, and LLM reinforcement learning (RL).

We calculate the similarity of counterspeech against a reference dataset... with the BLEU score, ROUGE, METEOR, and BERTScore. The quality of generated texts is evaluated by the GRUEN metrics... Finally, we calculate the type-token ratio and distinct-n-grams to evaluate the diversity of generated texts.
